title: Fourth of July Rager Ends With Adults, Teen Arrested
description:
Body cameras caught the chaotic events surrounding a wild Fourth of July party in Glocester, Rhode Island, that left three facing charges. Police took Rachel Hernandez, 37, Bryan Borzell, 48, and Alexander Borzell into custody, accusing two of providing alcohol to minors and one of simple assault for allegedly kicking an officer. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
